You’ll help our community move, connect, and thrive on the gym floor and beyond.

If you love people, movement, and making every moment count, this is your playground.

In Case You Don’t Know Who We Are

Known for being the rule breakers in hospitality, TSH is a fun, creative, and inspiring environment where everyone can work, stay, learn, and play, and most importantly be themselves. As an employer, we look, act, and think like a hotel, but instead we offer a lot more. Think student accommodation, long and short stay options, gyms, talks, events, rooftop bar, and eat and drink escapes, as well as community and coworking spaces. Located in The Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Italy, France, and Spain, with several new openings on the way, this hybrid hospitality concept may take root in the heart of Europe, but our plans are set for going global.

What You’ll Do

Host the space, lead and support a team of JIM Hosts who greet, guide, and connect with members and guests
Read the room, sense energy, tension, and joy, and adapt your presence to lift the collective experience
Curate a moving experience, design formats, moments, and interactions that feel alive and inclusive
Build an affirming and joyful culture, shaping the creative direction of JIM programming
Manage the environment, create spaces that are physically and psychologically safe, where lighting, music, scent, and tone all matter
Coordinate the details, oversee trainer scheduling, bookings, and invoices so everything runs smoothly
Connect the Hub, collaborate with Membership, Events, and F&B teams to create joined up social experiences

What You’ll Have

You bring warmth, humour, and intuition
You notice small details that make big differences
You model presence over perfection
You have experience in events, facilitation, performing arts, hospitality, or community building
Traditional gym or fitness experience is welcome but not required
You believe movement should feel enjoyable, coaching is a conversation, and belonging is strength
You lead while letting others shine

What We Offer

The opportunity to work at a dynamic, multi national company, not just another hotel, we’re a game changing innovator, challenging every convention and defining the future
The opportunity to work for a Certified B Corp® company that balances profit with positive impact, collaborating with organizations like Movement on the Ground and the TSH Talent Foundation to create meaningful change
The chance to learn and grow in your role with the potential for future growth
Awesome discounts in all our properties in Europe, and not just for you, but also for your friends and family
A wonderful workplace to call home, full of events, fun colleagues, and all the other amazing salary and benefits stuff

At The Social Hub, we believe pay should be fair and consistent. That's why we carefully determine your starting salary based on the role, your assessed proficiency, and our salary framework. We make our best and fairest offer upfront, so we don't negotiate salaries. Because fairness shouldn’t depend on who negotiates best.

Starting salary: 25.255,14€ gross per year

Who you are is how we want you to be. To us, hybrid hospitality goes across the board, from how we service our guests to how we represent ourselves.
